Name: Full Inventory View
Author: Cpdncristiano
Description:
[b]Full Inventory View[/b]
This mod enhances the inventory system in [i]Stardew Valley[/i] by allowing you to view your expanded inventory rows clearly. By default, the game only shows up to three rows, but with this mod, the interface dynamically scales to display your items properly, making it much easier to organize and manage everything at a glance.

[b]🚀 What's New in This Version:[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Native Shop Support:[/b] Improved compatibility and rendering support for native in-game shop menus.
[*] [b]Scrollbar Integration:[/b] Added a dynamic scrollbar to handle extremely large inventory expansions seamlessly without breaking the UI. (Yes, even if you are running a massive 512-slot backpack mod!)
[/list]
⚠️ [b]Important:[/b]
This mod [b]does not increase[/b] inventory capacity on its own. It only updates the visual representation and layout to support massive sizes. To actually increase your inventory capacity, you still need to use a companion mod like [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21591]The Return Of More Backpack Upgrades[/url][/b].
